_notice: SYNTHETIC HOLD-OUT EXAMPLES. Written after the rules were finished and run ONCE without changing any rules afterwards, to get a less optimistic picture than synthetic_eval.json (which was used while developing). Still written by the development team, so still NOT real-world evidence. isiXhosa examples need checking by a fluent speaker.

examples.text: Main line burst on Ntshekisa Road, water everywhere
